name: Moon · Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow)
subtitle: Apollo 17 landing site, Taurus-Littrow valley · 2.46 × 2.46 km area · NASA data (LROC NAC, LRO CRaTER)
notes: Image: LROC NAC mosaic A17_60x60km.eq, zoom 15, NASA Moon Trek.
Elevation and slope: LROC NAC DTM NAC_DTM_APOLLO17 (5 m), in ~2.4 m cells. Features smaller than ~10 m do not appear.

Radiation: reference 5.1 µGy/h (silicon) derived from LRO CRaTER in 50 km orbit (Mazur et al. 2011): /0.7 to open space, ×0.5 for the Moon blocking half the sky. Map = that value × visible sky fraction.
No thermal, mineral or traverse layers on this body: no sand penalty and no mineral suggestions; mark points on the map.
Speed uses the Tobler walking function (an Earth model) with v0 = 2.0 km/h, an assumption for Apollo-style suited walking.
doseNote: LRO CRaTER thin detectors ~173 uGy/day (Si) in 50 km orbit, Sep 2009-Feb 2010 (Mazur et al. 2011, Space Weather, doi:10.1029/2010SW000641); /0.7 orbit->interplanetary, x0.5 half sky at the surface
attribution: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University (LROC) · NASA Moon Trek · Leaflet
